title: The Basics of Semiconductor Cleaning, "RCA Clean": What's in SC-1 and SC-2 and Why the Order Matters
excerpt: An explanation of RCA cleaning, the foundation of semiconductor cleaning. Learn the roles of SC-1 and SC-2, how they remove organics, particles, and metals, and why they are used in this order, with worked calculations, as Lesson 3 of Cleaning Level 3. Includes a word review and common misunderstandings.
